Web JavaScript Reference Statements and declarations

open_graph.og:title: Statements and declarations - JavaScript | MDN
open_graph.og:description: JavaScript code is built from statements and declarations, which can contain expressions. This reference groups the constructs used to control execution and declare bindings. A statement can span multiple lines, and a line can contain multiple statements.
